HERO.TITLE: Draya
HERO.TAGLINE_SUB: For teachers' students and learning centers
HERO.DESCRIPTION: AI-powered exam generation, weakness detection, and verified parent reports.

BENEFITS.HEADING: An Integrated Work System for Teachers
BENEFITS.SUBTITLE: Designed with leading teachers to simplify academic workloads and learning centers.
BENEFITS.B1_DESC: Not a generic AI — it reads your videos and files and generates questions from within them, not from a generic database.
BENEFITS.B2_DESC: Every report and exam generated by AI passes through you first. Nothing reaches anyone without your explicit approval.
BENEFITS.B3_DESC: The weakness map reveals every student by name — not empty averages, real data you can act on.
BENEFITS.B4_DESC: Arabic RTL interface designed for Egyptian teachers and learning centers — not a translation, designed from scratch for our context.
BENEFITS.B5_DESC: From login to your first published lecture in two minutes. No training course or technical experience needed.
BENEFITS.B6_DESC: Draya students improve their grades by an average of 31% in the first 3 months — not marketing talk, real data.

FEATURES.HEADING: Full Control & Transparency
FEATURES.F1_DESC: Create your packages, courses, and lectures, and attach video, homework, and exams all from one screen — no tool switching.
FEATURES.F1_I1: Create packages and courses in simple steps
FEATURES.F1_I2: Upload video and PDF in the same screen
FEATURES.F1_I3: Publish or save lectures as drafts instantly
FEATURES.F2_TITLE: All Your Content in Clear Progression
FEATURES.F2_DESC: Package → Course → Lecture. Track your progress, review homework and exams, and recall your weak points with one click.
FEATURES.F2_I1: Organized learning path for each subject
FEATURES.F2_I3: My grades + weak points + revision link
FEATURES.F3_TITLE: AI as an Assistant, Not a Controller
FEATURES.F3_DESC: Generates questions from your lecture content and composes performance reports — but you're the one who approves and sends.
FEATURES.F3_I1: Generate 20 questions in 30 seconds from video or PDF
FEATURES.F3_I3: All AI content clearly labeled — no mixing with teacher content

TESTIMONIALS.HEADING: Hundreds of Teachers Trust Us
TESTIMONIALS.T1_QUOTE: Draya saved me hours in exam preparation — and most importantly, the AI suggests but I approve. That's crucial for credibility with parents.
TESTIMONIALS.T2_QUOTE: Students track their own progress — I no longer need to create sheets and update everything manually. Reports reach parents faster and clearer.
TESTIMONIALS.T3_QUOTE: Parent reports used to take me a full day. Now they're done in minutes and I just review, approve, and send. Time that will change my life.

FAQ.HEADING: Questions Teachers Always Ask
FAQ.Q1: Can I try Draya for free?
FAQ.A1: Yes, you can start with the free Basic plan without a credit card. It supports up to 50 students, 2 courses, and a set of basic features.
FAQ.Q2: Is Draya fully supported in Arabic?
FAQ.A2: Yes, absolutely. The platform is designed RTL-first for Egyptian teachers and students — the interface, reports, and support are all in Arabic.
FAQ.Q3: How does AI work in Draya?
FAQ.A3: The AI reads lecture content (video or PDF) and generates questions and performance reports. But the teacher reviews and approves before any delivery to students or parents — no automatic sending.
FAQ.Q4: Does the platform suit large centers?
FAQ.A4: Yes. The Enterprise plan is tailored for large centers and includes white-label, API integration, and a dedicated account manager. Contact us for pricing.
FAQ.A5: We accept Visa and Mastercard credit cards, and Egyptian e-wallets (Vodafone Cash, Orange Cash). Annual payment saves 20%.
